senses.gloss: raśanā́, f. cord; strap; rein. [cf. raśmi.]

raśmí, m.
 —1. line, cord;
 —2. fig. (line,
i. e.) ray, of light; beam. [so Eng. ray
involves a metaphor, its Lat. predecessor
radius meaning orig. ‘staff’ and then
‘spoke’: cf. raśanā́ and rāśí.]

rasā́, f.
 —1. moisture;
 —2. Rasā, a
mythical stream supposed to flow round
the earth and atmosphere. [cf. rása.]

rasika, a. tasty; as m. connoisseur. [rasa,
1222.]

rāśí, m. troop, host; heap. [perhaps
akin w. raśmí, q. v.: for connection of
mg, cf. Eng. line and French cordon, as
applied to soldiers.]

rāṣṭrī́ya, a. belonging to the sovereignty;
as m. sovereign, ruler. [rāṣṭra, 1215.]
